structure.unit: Titling and Registration of Motor Vehicles

law.catch_line: Operation for hire of certain vehicles registered as not-for-hire; penalty
law.text: If a motor vehicle of over 10,000 pounds registered gross weight that is registered to be operated exclusively not-for-hire is operated for-hire, the licensee shall be guilty of a traffic infraction. This penalty shall be in addition to the penalty prescribed by § 46.2-704.
